response.evidence: Application denials are a small share of the records (roughly 10%), and Hispanic or Latino male applicants are denied at a rate similar to the overall rate, with no clear excess. Denials cluster strongly among applications with high debt-to-income ratios (>50% or >60%), which appear across all racial and sex groups. The data does not include credit scores, employment, or other underwriting variables, and it cannot rule out discrimination through factors not recorded here, so confidence is moderate.
